verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no in-product feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from a user's own data. Vertex AI is described as a platform for building agents, and MCP Toolbox for Databases (with NL2SQL) connects external agents to databases. Both are developer building blocks or external-agent connectors, not a built-in insights capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
